content.short: USD receiving and cross-border freelancer payments with stablecoin settlement signals.
content.description: Higlobe is a cross-border payments platform that helps freelancers and remote workers in countries like the Philippines and across Latin America receive money from US and European clients without losing large amounts to fees. Users get a US-based receiving account to collect USD from employers and platforms, then convert and withdraw to their local bank in local currency at low, transparent rates. Behind the scenes, Higlobe leans on stablecoin settlement rails to move value quickly and cheaply across borders, while keeping the user experience fully fiat and familiar. Positioned as a lowest-cost money-transfer service for professionals earning in dollars, Higlobe focuses on fast payouts and keeping more of each payment in the earner's pocket.
content.meta: Higlobe helps freelancers receive USD and cash out locally at low cost. Discover Higlobe and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
